verdict.rationale: HubSpot is a SaaS CRM with embedded AI features (Breeze agents, AI reporting), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, policy, or contractual commitment that prevents customer data from being used to train AI models. The AI-feature marketing and MCP access docs describe AI use of CRM data, not training controls.
